name: AGENDA 11/15/2022 SPECIAL
agenda_text:
CITY OF SAN GABRIEL
  CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

  Tuesday, November 15, 2022 - 5:30 P.M.

  City Hall, Conference Room A
  425 South Mission Drive
  San Gabriel, California 91776

  Tony Ding
  Mayor  Mark Lazzaretto
  City Manager
  John R. Harrington
  Vice Mayor  Keith Lemieux
  City Attorney
  Denise Menchaca
  Council Member  Julie Nguyen
  City Clerk
  Carina Rivera
  Council Member  Kevin B. Sawkins
  City Treasurer
  John Wu
  Council Member

In addition to providing public comment in person at the meeting, the following opportunity
has been established:

Public Comment
Please email all public comment on items on this agenda only to cityclerk@sgch.org and
include the following on the subject line of your email: PUBLIC COMMENT: 11/15/2022 Special
Meeting. The Clerk will read public comment into the record for up to the three-minute limit.
Words that would disrupt the meeting, including profanity, obscenity, and discriminatory
language, will not be read. All public comments shall be e-mailed by 4:00 P.M. on meeting day.
   City Council Special Meeting Agenda
  Tuesday, November 15, 2022

 •  CALL TO ORDER
 •  ROLL CALL: Mayor Ding, Vice Mayor Harrington, Council Members Menchaca,
  Rivera, Wu

 1. CLOSED SESSION

  A. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – POTENTIAL LITIGATION
  (§54956.9(d)(2))

  The Council will meet in a closed session with legal counsel to discuss a matter
  that the City Attorney has determined poses a significant exposure to litigation
  pursuant to Government Code §54956.9(d)(2) - (one potential case).

  B. PUBLIC EMPLOYEE PERFORMANCE EVALUATION (§ 54957)

  Title: City Attorney

  C. CONFERENCE  WITH  LABOR  NEGOTIATOR  (GOVERNMENT  CODE
  §54957.6)

  City Negotiators – City Manager Lazzaretto, City Attorney Keith Lemieux, and
  Human Resources/Risk Management Director Macias.

  Regarding the following Employee Organizations – San Gabriel Police Officers’
  Association, San Gabriel Police Management Group, San Gabriel Firefighters’
  Association, San Gabriel Fire Management Group and all Unrepresented
  Employees.

 2. ADJOURNMENT

  The next regular City Council meeting will be held on Tuesday, November 15, 2022,
  at 6:30 P.M. Information regarding matters to be considered at each meeting will
  be available on the Friday before the City Council meeting on the City’s website at
  www.sangabrielcity.com.

Persons with Disabilities. Upon request, this Agenda will be made available in
appropriate alternative formats to persons with disabilities, as required by Section 202 of
the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.
Persons requesting a Translator. Any person requesting translation for the meeting
must notify the City Clerk Department at cityclerk@sgch.org at least 48 hours before the
meeting.
Questions about this Agenda? Should any person have a question concerning any of
the above Agenda items prior to the meeting, please contact the City Clerk at
cityclerk@sgch.org during regular office hours.

Any person with a disability who requires a modification or accommodation in order to
participate in a meeting should direct such a request to the City Clerk Department by
emailing cityclerk@sgch.org at least 48 hours before the meeting, if possible.
